content: Hyperglycemia, defined as elevated blood glucose levels, has been linked to cognitive decline, especially in older adults diagnosed with diabetes. Maintaining tight glycemic control has demonstrated efficacy in slowing the progression of cognitive impairment in this population. Research underscores the critical importance of keeping blood glucose levels within recommended target ranges to preserve cognitive function and overall brain health. However, it is important to note that overly aggressive glucose-lowering therapies can lead to hypoglycemic episodes, which may exacerbate cognitive decline and pose additional risks to neurological health.
